style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun through glass, high exposure
motion_rule: one clear action per window and only one of them moves at a time; he never holds a pose; camera move and new shot size every window, never on a schedule; his antennae whip in speech too
character: a glossy red lobster, long whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug, selling the place like a realtor
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie with a tape measure and a brass key, measuring and hauling things past the lens, never still
props: ONE restaurant fish tank seen from inside; ONE toy castle on the gravel; ONE tape measure; ONE brass key; ONE giant lemon and a pot on a board beyond the glass; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the lemon and the pot beyond the glass from 0.0 on, bigger every window; the castle loses its turret at 1.8 and stays broken
environment: inside a sunlit restaurant tank, gravel floor, bright kitchen beyond the glass

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smooth realtor patter, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ku-DA, vlo-ZHIT stress last, ne-DVI-zhi-most stress second, STU-di-yu stress first, u va-DY stress last, KUH-nyu, za-TO svoy, ne-na-DOL-ga stress third
audio.pacing: 0.9-2.7 one breath; one pause, 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open and close on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: water gulping, glass taps, claw snaps, a big splash

timeline.a: the crab shoots the tape measure across the lens and it clangs on the glass
he kicks the castle door open and scuttles out through the gravel
he rears on his tail, both claws thrown wide, bubbles bursting off him
he slaps the big claw on the castle and the turret snaps clean off
no words. The crab hauls the brass key past the lens and drops it in the gravel
he walks the camera round the tiny broken castle on his tail
he taps the glass twice, water sloshing above him
he turns the crab to the glass, the giant lemon and the pot right beyond it
timeline.c: over him, rack to the lemon

timeline.a: he plants the big claw on the castle roof and puffs up
he scuttles at the camera till his face fills the frame
no words. A broad shadow slides across the gravel and the water goes still
the crab grabs the key and bolts inside the castle
the lemon drops into the water beside him, spray blasting up
he winks and rides the bobbing lemon up past the lens

must_appear: the tape measure clanging on the glass at 0.0, the turret snapping off at 1.8, the lemon and the pot beyond the glass at 4.75, the lemon dropping into the water at 8.6, him riding it in the wink at 9.3
